_comment: Commander bracket rules. Sources: the Commander Format Panel bracket system, introduced at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/introducing-commander-brackets-beta (2025-02-11), revised at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/commander-brackets-beta-update-october-21-2025 (2025-10-21), and updated at https://magic.wizards.com/en/news/announcements/commander-brackets-beta-update-february-9-2026 (2026-02-09). The 2025-02-11 article was read again on 2026-09-02 for the Game Changer limits and the content rules, and the 2025-10-21 article for the expected turns and the end of every tutor limit. The content rules are the machine-checkable form of the prose (F-11, PR-14A). mass_land_denial says whether the bracket allows it. max_extra_turn_cards is the count of extra-turn cards the bracket allows, and -1 means no limit: the article says none at bracket 1 and low quantities, never chained, at 2 and 3. Commander Spellbook reads two such cards as chained, so the count is 1 (estimate_bracket in variant.py, read 2026-09-02). max_combo_speed is the fastest two-card infinite combo the bracket allows, on Spellbook's speed scale: 5 needs no mana, 4 needs four or less, 3 six or less, 2 eight or less, 1 more. 0 means none, and -1 no limit. Bracket 3 forbids a cheap combo in about the first six turns, which is speed 4 and up, so it allows 3. Bracket 2 allows a slow one, speed 2, as Spellbook's Core reading does. An extra-turn combo is forbidden wherever max_extra_turn_cards is not -1. A Game Changer commander counts as one of the three at Bracket 3, and can not play in Brackets 1 and 2 (the engine counts the command zone, D-60). verified_at is the date of the last full check. -1 means no limit.
